test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the volume (in cm³) of a sphere having a diameter of 8 cm, giving your answer correct to two places of decimal.

Take π = (22)/(7)
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

**Calculation:**

Diameter of the sphere = 8 cm

Radius of the sphere, r = 4 cm

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

⇒ (4)/(3)times(22)/(7) (4)³

⇒ 268.19 cm³

∴ Volume of sphere = 268.19 cm3

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
